caption: The drawing depicts a round, dark brown wooden table identified as a tilt-top table made of mahogany. The tabletop is circular with a polished surface, supported by a single central pedestal that is turned and ornamented, extending down into three elegantly curved legs that end in claw-shaped feet. Above the table, there is a boxed label with text in black lettering reading: "TILT-TOP TABLE MAHOGANY AMERICAN THIRD QUARTER OF THE XVIIIth CENTURY 25-115-34." The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the drawing is signed in the bottom right corner with the name "Holger Hansen." There is another illegible signature or text in the bottom left corner. The composition is centered on the page, and the table is rendered with a realistic use of shading and highlight to suggest its three-dimensional form and glossy finish.
title: Tilt-top Table
